newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BOURSE CONTINUES STRONG RUN.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - BOURSE CONTINUES STRONG RUN.

text.p: Stocks on the Botswana Stock
Exchange had another good run last week with the domestic
companies index closing 7.95 points up to reach 491.32 points.
The index has now risen 21 weeks in a row.
Barclays forged ahead, trading at 775 thebe.
Botswana Insurance continued to perform well, closing
10 thebe up at 270 thebe. First National put 30 thebe
closing at 550 thebe.
Milling company and food wholesaler Sefalana
continued its recent bull run closing at 510 thebe, a rise of 20
thebe on the week.
Oil company Engen was unchanged at 450 thebe and
security group Inco also unchanged at 110 thebe.
On the foreign board car rental and fleet management group
Avis put on 54 thebe to 679 thebe; De Beers
added 264 thebe to close at 12,983 thebe and McCarthy Retail
group lost 133 thebe to close at 967 thebe. All three
counters traded in small parcels.
The foreign index gained 7.01 points to close at 397.88 and
the all companies index added 7.03 points to 400.28.
